name: LocalRecord
author: Antoine Artillan
description: Record mic + desktop audio from the bar

barWidget.description: Recording state and elapsed time, with a panel holding every setting and the last recording

schema.label: Show elapsed time
schema.description: Show the running length next to the icon while recording. Vertical bars never show it, for lack of room.

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Keep the widget out of the bar until a recording starts.
